name: AI Chatbot Builder
author: KingAddons.com

sections.description:
AI Chatbot Builder is a powerful WordPress plugin that brings OpenAI’s GPT models (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo) directly to your website, enabling you to create intelligent, interactive chatbots without writing any code. Key features include:
* Seamless OpenAI GPT Integration via API for advanced conversational AI.
* No-code setup: easily configure API keys, select models, and set daily token limits.
* Real-time token management: define usage quotas, monitor daily consumption, and control costs.
* Fully customizable chat widget: adjust colors, fonts, borders, and style presets to match your brand.
* Contextual memory for multi-turn conversations that feel natural and personalized.
* Easy embedding with [aichatbot_chat] shortcode, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget support.
* Mobile-first and responsive design with ARIA accessibility and keyboard navigation.
* Security and standards compliance: sanitize inputs, escape outputs, and use nonce verification for AJAX calls.

Empower your WordPress site with AI-driven chatbots for customer support, lead generation, and engaging user interactions—all without a single line of code!

External services

This plugin connects to OpenAI’s API to provide AI-powered chatbot functionality. The connection is required for the core functionality of generating AI responses to user messages.

Service: OpenAI API (api.openai.com)
Purpose: To generate intelligent responses to user chat messages using GPT models (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, etc.)

Data sent:
– User chat messages and conversation history (when memory is enabled)
– Your OpenAI API key for authentication
– Selected AI model configuration

When data is sent:
– When users send messages through the chatbot interface
– When administrators refresh the available models list in plugin settings
– No data is sent when the plugin is inactive or no chat interactions occur

Data processing:
– Messages are sent securely via HTTPS to OpenAI’s servers
– OpenAI processes the messages to generate AI responses
– Conversation history may be included for context (if memory feature is enabled)
– No user data is stored on OpenAI’s servers beyond the API call (according to OpenAI’s data usage policy for API)

Required user action:
– You must obtain your own OpenAI API key and accept OpenAI’s terms
– Users interacting with the chatbot implicitly consent to their messages being processed by OpenAI’s API

Legal documentation:
– OpenAI Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
– OpenAI API Data Usage Policies: https://openai.com/policies/api-data-usage-policies

Important: This plugin requires an active OpenAI API account with available credits. API usage is charged according to OpenAI’s pricing structure. You are responsible for monitoring and managing your API usage and costs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-chatbot-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘AI Chatbot Builder Settings’ in the admin sidebar to set your OpenAI API key and configure options.
